purpose: Define typed, versioned transformations applied between mapped source and destination fields, including unit conversion, parsing, normalization and explicit lossiness.

topics.name: DWH Ingest Transformation Profile
topics.purpose: Define typed, versioned transformations applied between mapped source and destination fields, including unit conversion, parsing, normalization and explicit lossiness.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant transformation/profile has an explicit identity/version.
semantics.input_rule: Transformation inputs are exact mapped source/intermediate refs.
semantics.output_rule: Transformation outputs target exact destination/intermediate identities.
semantics.loss_rule: Lossy transformations explicitly declare discarded/unrepresentable information.
semantics.unit_rule: Unit conversion requires explicit compatible unit identities/profile.
semantics.determinism_rule: Deterministic transformations produce semantically equivalent output for equivalent input/profile.
semantics.provenance_rule: Transformation provenance is attached to accepted output lineage.
semantics.authority_rule: Transformation itself grants no destination write authority.

invariants.rule: External/input data enters DWH only through explicit source profiles, exact field/schema mappings and validated transformations; mapping never transfers ownership, fabricates missing semantics or bypasses origin governance.

hard_gates.condition: unit conversion guessed from display text
hidden arbitrary code used without declared profile
